verses.text: ash shiinu muhjamatan wal kaafu war raa-u
lir raa-i wal baa-i wahwal baa-u war raa-u
raa-un wa baa-un lahu maqluubuhu wa lahu
albaa-u wal haa-u bil ihmaali war raa-u
haa-ii wa miimii wa daalii laayazaalu lahu
halal lazii fiihi baanal baa-u war raa-u
haa-an wa daalan wa yaa-an minhu  jaa-a bihi
alyaa-u was siinu wahwat taa-u wal haa-u
kaafii wa laamii bihi ahtaytuhu alifan
allaamu min bahdihi wal laamu wal haa-u
haynan wa baa-an wa dalan laayazaalu bihi
khaa-an wa daalan wa miyman qablahu yaa-u
lis siiri wal yaa-i summad daali muhmalatan
shawqan limiimin wa wa-iw bahdahu taa-u
daalii wa faa-ii wa haynii kulla azminatin
bihi kajiimii bilaami bahdahu baa-u
fad daadu muhjamatan war raa-u faaraqanii
wa baa-a bil khusni hannil khaa-u wal baa-u
saadi wa daalii wa raa-iil yawma jaa-a lahu
ash shinu muhjamatan war raa-u wal haa-u
faa-ii wa qaafii wa raa-id dahra munsariqun
liman lahul haynu summa zaayu wat taa-u
kaafii wa nuunii wa zaayii zikruhu wa bihi
alkhaa-u muhjamatan wal yaa-u war raa-u
mahal lazii qalbu daahin jaabihi fahadaa
haa-an wa daalan wa yaa-a bahda haasaa-u
nuunan wa waa-an wa raa-an nastadii-u bihi
mahmah taraa qalba bidhin dimnuhu daa-u
akrim biman hazaduunal aqrabiina mahan
maqluuba barqin wa zaakal haa-u wal baa-u
wajjahtu wajhii lirabbi bin nabii abadan
minii lahul qaaqu summal laamu wal baa-u
lillaahi siinii wa raa-ii wahdahu wa lahu
subhaanahul jiimu summal haa-u war raa-u
saadi wa waawii wa miymii maa hayiitu lahu
wa misluhul faa-u summat taa-u war raa-u
raa-an wa jiiman wa haynaa bahdahu alifun
qad huztu han jumlatin yaatii bihaa daa-u
lahun siraa fiya hanhal yawma mubtaghiyan
an laa yunaazi hanii lil harsi ahdaa-u
wahwal hakiimul lazii lii qad qadaa wa tani
min bahdi maakaada yus-il amra itraa-u
qadaa liyal haaja fil ahdaa-i mughtariban
wa haana lil yawma taaliiqun wa iqraa-u
qad haana lii kashqu asraanil kitaabi liman
lahu ilal hilmi wal ahmaali hawjaa-u
qad haana raddii ilaa daanii liluzhira maa
bihi zawul khayri wal islaahi qad jaa-uu
allaahu nuurus samaa wal ardii munfaridan
wa laysa yutfi-u nuural laahi itfaa-u
wa man yurid kawna maa ahlaahu munsafilan
falaysa yukhfil lazii abdaahu ikhfaa-u
waman yurid kawna maa yukhfiihi zaa halanin
falaysa yuhlinu maa yukhfiihi ibdaa-u
hamdii wa shukrii wa ridwaanii lahu abadan
bitil badiihati minnii wah-ya sawdaa-u
yaa man yuwwa miluhaa qaltatta-id nazaran
innal qasiidata sawdaa-un wa gharraa-u
wal tadhu lii wal taqul yaa man taraa lughazii
tabaarakal laahu nihmal baa-u war raa-u
wa fil qasiidati raa-aatun mukarraratun
wa laysa fiiha bihamdil laahi itaa-u
sallaa wa sallama wahhaabu bihaa karaman
qad jaada lii wahwa fattaahun wa mihtaa-u
halaa bashiirin naziirin sirtu khaadimahu
wahwal lazii jaa-ahu sabwun wa ihlaa-u
muhammadun qaa-idi fil muksi mah safari
bil hisbi maaftatanat lil huzni saklaa-u
yaa rabbi yaa man lahu maqluubuhu wa lahu
maqluubu rahbin wa ghabraa-un wa khadraa-u
lishkur shukuuri wa hab lii faw wa matlabatii
yaa man lahu alifun wal miimu war raa-u
wash had bi-anniya radin hanka multamisan
an daama minni ilaykad dahra irdaa-u
shukri wa kulliyyatii dunyaa wa aakhiratan
lil baa-i war raa-i nihmar raa-u wal baa-u
habdan lahu wa khadiiman kulla azminatin
littaa-i wal haa-i wahwal haa-u wal baa-u
sallaa halayhi bitasliimin wa sallamanii
min kulli maa fiyhi daadu bahdahu raa-u
bil aali was sahbi hattaa bashsharal kuramaa
bitalhatii maha baa-i bahdahu raa-u
bihi wa faaraqanil aswaa-u wal lu-amaa
turran wa bii faaza ghayrun bahdahu raa-u
